data.action: 咖啡馆开店前把咖啡豆与小白花放入捧花，闻到点心香后放松微笑
data.description: 【星光咖啡馆露台·清晨】栞那穿着带围裙式腰饰的白色婚纱，站在刚开店的露台旁，把咖啡豆与小白花一起放进捧花；她闻到第一炉点心的香气便弯起眼睛，像把日常工作变成了婚礼。
data.lighting: soft morning light over the pastry window
data.mood: 把长年手艺写进花嫁日常
data.promptProse: Kanna Akizuki from YUZUSOFT wears a white bridal dress with a café-apron waist detail, rose-gold buttons and a small coffee-flower bouquet. She stands on the café terrace before opening, arranging a few coffee beans and small white flowers within the bouquet. The first pastry aroma reaches her and turns her practiced smile into a relaxed one, while the pale veil catches the morning light above the quiet shop. soft morning light over the pastry window.
data.title: 明月栞那 · 星光咖啡馆的白色花嫁
